edits.original: the architecture of modern power systems has evolved dramatically to accommodate larger scales
edits.replacement: the architecture of modern power systems has evolved to accommodate larger scales
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the sentence carries its meaning without it.

edits.original: so the retune significantly shortens frequency restoration
edits.replacement: so the retune shortens frequency restoration from 12 minutes to 4 minutes
edits.reason: "Significantly" is an intensifier; the numbers already in the sentence (12 minutes to 4 minutes) are the evidence it was standing in for.

edits.original: Inertia still matters for the first few cycles after a trip, full stop.
edits.replacement: Inertia still matters for the first few cycles after a trip.
edits.reason: "Full stop" is a finality interjection tacked onto a claim; the sentence already stands on its own without the emphatic padding.

edits.original: resistive losses (I²R) fall dramatically as current decreases
edits.replacement: resistive losses (I²R) fall as current decreases
edits.reason: "Dramatically" is an intensifier placeholder for evidence; the physical relationship (I²R losses falling as current decreases) is self-evident.

edits.original: The 345 kV reconductor significantly reduces line losses from 8 percent to 3 percent.
edits.replacement: The 345 kV reconductor reduces line losses from 8 percent to 3 percent.
edits.reason: "Significantly" is an intensifier; the specific numbers (8 percent to 3 percent) are the evidence it was standing in for.

edits.original: Islanded operation is the only backup path for those hospitals, end of story.
edits.replacement: Islanded operation is the only backup path for those hospitals.
edits.reason: "End of story" is a finality interjection tacked onto a claim that already carries its own exclusivity marker ("only"); the marker already did the emphatic work.
